normal_reference_training.purpose: normalization, DPCA fit, limits and H3 thresholds only

h1.first_indication_incidence: runs with at least one eligible post-onset raw ANOMALY divided by all evaluated fault-test runs
h1.confirmed_detection_incidence: runs with at least one candidate confirmed by ANOMALY at its own k+R verification window divided by all evaluated fault-test runs
h1.detection_rate: runs with at least one confirmed post-onset alarm divided by all evaluated fault-test runs
h1.no_detection_rate: runs with no confirmed post-onset alarm divided by all evaluated fault-test runs

false_alarm_rate_normal_holdout.raw_anomaly_window_rate: raw ANOMALY windows divided by all scheduled normal-holdout windows
false_alarm_rate_normal_holdout.raw_false_alarm_run_incidence: runs with at least one raw ANOMALY divided by all evaluated normal-holdout runs
false_alarm_rate_normal_holdout.confirmed_false_alarm_run_incidence: runs with at least one full-sample-refresh-confirmed candidate divided by all evaluated normal-holdout runs
false_alarm_rate_normal_holdout.time_to_first_confirmed_false_alarm: minutes from sample 1 to the first confirmed false-alarm verification endpoint, when present

false_alarm_rate_prefault.numerator: runs with a candidate and its k+R verification endpoint both in sample 1..160 and both ANOMALY

h1.opportunity_level_rates: reported separately for normal holdout and pre-fault; their numerators and denominators are never pooled
h1.abstentions_in_denominator: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT does not remove a run from H1 denominators

h2.llm_first_indication: earliest eligible post-onset window endpoint whose raw categorical decision is ANOMALY
h2.llm_confirmed_detection: earliest candidate k whose own k+R verification window is also ANOMALY
h2.candidate_concurrency: every eligible ANOMALY starts its own candidate; candidates coexist and resolve independently
h2.candidate_failure: a non-ANOMALY at k+R fails only candidate k and does not cancel other pending candidates
h2.trajectory_end: each candidate whose k+R is beyond the trajectory is VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE_END_OF_TRAJECTORY
h2.dpca_confirmed_alarm: third consecutive sample with a raw DPCA exceedance
h2.explicit_onset_reset: LLM candidates and DPCA persistence state are reset at sample 161 for evaluator post-onset metrics
h2.no_carryover: a pre-onset candidate cannot verify across sample 161
h2.post_onset_confirmation: candidate endpoint k and verification endpoint k+R must both be post-onset eligible
h2.prefault_confirmation: candidate and verification endpoints must both be <=160 and are reported only as pre-fault false alarm
h2.abstention: EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT is a categorical non-ANOMALY; it fails a candidate only when it occurs at that candidate's k+R and remains in denominators
h2.first_indication_delay_samples: first eligible post-onset raw ANOMALY endpoint minus 161
h2.confirmed_detection_delay_samples: first confirmed candidate verification endpoint minus 161
h2.execution_without_detection: detected=false and detection delay=null; no maximum delay is imputed
h2.internal_time_only: window_id, sample_start and sample_end are read from scientific records and are never exposed in the LLM payload
h2.tie_breaking: ascending sample/sample_end, then ascending window_id; first confirmed candidate in that deterministic order

h3.scope: deterministic verification of structured evidence against the exact numeric payload for the same window
h3.threshold_source: FaultFree Training only; 48500 causal windows using window=20, stride=5 and representation rounding
h3.variable_correspondence: evidence.variable must exactly equal one of the 52 identifiers and be present in the same window payload
h3.observation_role: human-readable audit and secondary qualitative analysis only; observation text never determines the primary claim classification or score
h3.evidence_item_score: 1 when variable correspondence is valid and the structured claim passes its numeric rule; otherwise 0
h3.response_score: mean evidence-item score; ANOMALY with no evidence scores 0; empty evidence for NORMAL or EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT is not applicable
h3.coverage: numerically verifiable evidence items divided by all evidence items
h3.run_aggregation: mean applicable response score within each simulationRun
h3.overall_aggregation: macro mean of applicable run scores, with distribution and coverage reported separately

aggregation.detected_only_delay_summary: count, mean, median, q25 and q75 among detected runs, accompanied by no_detection_rate
aggregation.llm_and_dpca: reported separately; DPCA output is never supplied to the LLM primary condition

validation: synthetic fixtures for confirmation-state tests; no target or FaultFree Testing access
